Press the Bell and Menu buttons a few times to see if they light up and if the menu appears. If not, replace the batteries, ensuring they are inserted correctly.

snippets.title: Programming, fixing or replacing your Bell Fibe TV remote

snippets.text: Your remote batteries may be weak and need replacing if you have to press the POWER button more than once to turn your Bell Satellite TV receiver on or off, or if you have to move closer to the receiver for the remote to work. To replace the batteries in your remote: Remove the battery cover on the back of your remote.
snippets.title: How to program my Bell Satellite TV remote control

snippets.text: To pair your remote using IR: With your Bell Streamer remote, select Settings from the left navigation menu. Under the Device section, select Universal remote. Follow the IR remote pairing process on the screen. Note: If the TV model is not auto-detected, you need to choose your TV manually from a list. If your TV does not appear in the list, IR is not supported. To adjust your Bell Streamer's volume when paired by IR: With your Bell Streamer remote, select Settings from the left navigation menu. Under the Device section select Volume control. Use the slider to adjust the volume to the desired level. If you're not able to resolve the issue following these steps, please contact us. Checking and replacing the batteries  - collapsed If the remote isn't working, check to see if your batteries are installed correctly or need to be replaced. The red light on the remote red light will blink several times when the batteries need to be replaced.
snippets.title: Help with the Bell Streamer remote

snippets.text: If the remote no longer responds, you may need to pair it again. To pair the remote with the Bell Streamer: Ensure the Bell Streamer is powered on. Hold and press the button on the Bell Streamer for three seconds to initiate the pairing. Follow on-screen instructions.
